title: Settings
description: Preferences of the editor, and the format of the thesis.

editor.fontFamilyHint: The typeface of the text in the editor.
editor.lineNumbersHint: Numbers every line of the text in the left margin, wrapped lines included.
editor.autosaveDelayHint: Slide to the right to save sooner after you stop typing.
editor.pasteMarkdownHint: Turn pasted Markdown into headings, lists and tables.
editor.previewDelay: Rebuild the preview after a save
editor.previewDelayHint: Slide to the right to rebuild the preview sooner after a save.
editor.statementStyleHint: Callout is a plain box, colored paints each kind.

advancedHint: Empty fields follow the school format. Changing a value overrides it for this thesis only.
noProject: Open a project to change the format of its thesis.

layout.first-line-indent-all: Indent the paragraph after a heading

page-number.format: Use {page} for the number, for example 第 {page} 頁. Empty hides it.

layout.font-latin: Separate several fonts with commas, the first available one is used.
layout.par-spacing: Empty keeps paragraphs on the line grid.
layout.first-line-indent: Empty picks 2 for Chinese and 1.5 for English.

placement.figure: Where a figure goes when it names no place.
placement.table: Where a table goes when it names no place. A long table is best kept here.

editorAppearance.title: Appearance
editorAppearance.description: How the text looks in the editor.

editorWriting.title: Writing
editorWriting.description: Block numbers, spell check, pasting and saving.

editorPreview.title: Preview
editorPreview.description: How the preview of the thesis is built.

thesisSchool.title: School and format
thesisSchool.description: The school decides the format. Changes are saved at once.

thesisInfo.title: Information
thesisInfo.description: What goes on the cover and the title page. Changes are saved at once.

thesisText.title: Text
thesisText.description: Fonts, size and spacing of the body text.

thesisHeadings.title: Headings and numbering
thesisHeadings.description: Heading sizes and alignment, and the numbering of footnotes and formulas.

thesisCaptions.title: Figures, tables and references
thesisCaptions.description: Captions and the words used for cross-references.

thesisPageNumber.title: Page numbers and outline
thesisPageNumber.description: Page numbers of the front and the main part, and the table of contents.

thesisBibliography.title: Bibliography
thesisBibliography.description: Title and listing of the references.

editorProfile.title: About you
editorProfile.description: What is true of you in every thesis. A new project starts with it.

editorStatements.title: Theorem blocks
editorStatements.description: How definitions, lemmas and theorems look in the editor. The PDF is not affected.

changedDot: This page has settings that differ from the school format

diagram.noRoom: The margins leave no room for text.
diagram.tildeHint: A tilde (~) adds space between characters.
diagram.badPattern: {{problem}} is not a placeholder that can be used. Use {C}, {S} and {B}.

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.hint: Drawn on the body pages of a final copy, and in the preview when you turn it on there.
watermark.schoolNone: This school has no watermark in the template.
watermark.noneBody: The thesis is built without one.
watermark.customBody: Choose a PNG, JPEG, SVG or PDF from your computer.
watermark.preview: Preview of the watermark on a page
watermark.rule: Whether a thesis needs a watermark depends on the school.

steps.describeSave: Saves about {{seconds}} after you stop typing.
steps.describePreview: Builds the preview about {{seconds}} after a save.

profile.ask: Ask when a project is created
profile.askHint: Turn it off and a new project starts with this, without a question.
profile.local: This stays on this computer, in the settings of the app.
